newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 28.385 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 28.385 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Tuesday, August 5, was fixed at 20.3850 percent, a decline of 20 basis points from 20.5850 percent, the rate for August 4, Banco de Mexico said on Monday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised every working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Tuesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
